convert_stable_cascade_prior: run the script to convert Stable Cascade stage C prior weights to a diffusers prior pipeline
convert_stable_cascade_decoder: run the script to convert Stable Cascade stage B decoder weights to a diffusers decoder pipeline
convert_stable_cascade_combined: run the script with --save_combined to create a combined Stable Cascade prior and decoder pipeline
convert_stable_cascade_safetensors: run the script with --use_safetensors to convert Stable Cascade weights from SafeTensors format
convert_stable_cascade_bf16: run the script with --variant bf16 to save the converted Stable Cascade pipeline in bfloat16 precision
